heading: 1.01.010 - Adoption.
text:
There is adopted the El Paso City Code, as compiled, edited and published by Book
Publishing Company, Seattle, Washington, with such additions or deletions as are included
in Section 1.01.080 of this chapter.

(Ord. 8773 § 1, 1986)
html:
There is adopted the El Paso City Code, as compiled, edited and published by Book Publishing Company, Seattle, Washington, with such additions or deletions as are included in Section 1.01.080 of this chapter.

(Ord. 8773 § 1, 1986)

heading: 1.01.020 - Title—Citation—Reference.
text:
This code shall be known as the El Paso Code and it shall be sufficient to refer to
the code as the El Paso City Code in any prosecution for the violation of any provision
thereof or in any proceeding at law or equity. It shall be sufficient to designate
any ordinance adding to, amending, correcting or repealing all or any part or portion
of the El Paso City Code. Further reference may be had to the title, chapters, sections
and subsections of the El Paso City Code and such references shall apply to that numbered
title, chapter, section or subsection as it appears in the code.

(Ord. 8773 § 2, 1986)

heading: 1.01.030 - Reference applies to all amendments.
text:
Whenever a reference is made to this code as the El Paso City Code or to any portion
thereof, or to any ordinance of the City of El Paso, Texas, codified in this code,
the reference shall apply to all amendments, corrections and additions heretofore,
now or hereafter made.

(Ord. 8773 § 3, 1986)
